bugs.what: A failed WITS 'lay the tablet against his words' check at the Fenmarch Priory was tagged 'costs standing with the Gray Church, hit or miss' and did indeed cost standing on the miss — technically correct, but the phrasing reads ambiguously as if only a hit costs, worth double-checking wording consistency across similar prompts.
bugs.where: Fenmarch / The Priory of the Gray Church

bugs.what: The 'drag the skiff free' might-check at the Ironbound Mission kept escalating DC after each failure (10→22 cap) with only a 1hp cost per try and no way to know in advance it capped that high; after 3 fails it became effectively unwinnable at my stat level, and there was no alternate route hinted at from that specific room (the real route to the drowned nave was reached from a completely different, non-obvious path via Reedholm's 'go out').

Wandering the Thornwold/Iron Downs border wood (Spoil Verge, Deer Break, Root Tangle, Ford Approach, Clawed Rock, Heartwood Hollow, Bramble Break) never surfaced a path to the actual 'Iron Downs'/Cinderhall hold despite ~25 turns of exploration; the region felt like unfinished or extremely deep content relative to its narrative prominence (two companion quests point there).
bugs.where: Thornwold western wood, en route to Iron Downs

confusions: The overworld direction labels (go north/south/east/west) are frequently flavor-only and don't consistently match the compass description in the room text (e.g. Hollow Path's 'east' led to Wolf Scrape, not the described sunken shrine); had to rely on status's 'as the wood/vale runs' bearings feature to actually navigate.
It was never clear how to physically reach the Iron Downs/Cinderhall hold from Thornwold — no signposted route despite two companion quests (Tamsin, and later Corporal Fenn's ring) pointing there.

Crossing into Marrowgate is flagged as 'final' with a warning to check status, but it wasn't obvious beforehand just how many companion/hold threads (13) would be permanently orphaned — a rough turn-cost estimate of what's left would have helped decide whether to backtrack first.
suggestions: Make directional exits' flavor text match their actual destination, or de-emphasize compass words in favor of named destinations in the menu.
Surface a 'route to Iron Downs' hint earlier or more directly, since two separate companion arcs depend on finding it and it was the one region I couldn't locate despite active searching.
Cap failing skill-check retries at a friendlier DC ceiling, or tell the player up front roughly how many tries are worth attempting before it's a lost cause.
Before the point-of-no-return crossing, show a one-line estimate ('~N turns to close out open companion threads') so players can make an informed choice instead of a blind gut call.
